c74object.name: void.sm.writer~
c74object.description:
void.sm.writer~ writes scalar control values derived from audio-rate signals into a POSIX shared memory segment following the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2).
Each signal inlet corresponds to one shared memory channel. Audio-rate signals are sampled at a fixed write rate and reduced to a single floating point value per channel.
The shared memory layout starts with a fixed header containing identity, versioning, topology, epoch, frame counter, and ownership information. This header is followed by one float value per channel, corresponding to a length of one sample per channel.
This object is designed to stream control data from Max to external processes such as TouchDesigner or other Max instances in a robust and deterministic way.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description:
Name of the POSIX shared memory segment.
Writers and readers must use the same name to communicate. This argument can also be set using the @name attribute.

objarg.name: channels
objarg.description:
Number of signal inlets and shared memory channels.
This value is fixed at object creation time and cannot be changed dynamically.

inlet.description:
Audio-rate control signals written to shared memory.
One signal inlet is created per channel. Each inlet contributes one scalar value to the shared memory segment.

outlet.description:
Outputs status messages describing the shared memory state.
The waiting message indicates that the writer is enabled but cannot yet create a valid shared memory segment.
The connected message indicates that the shared memory segment has been successfully created and mapped.
The disconnected message indicates that the writer is disabled or the DSP is turned off.
The error_open message indicates that the shared memory segment could not be created or mapped.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment.
Changing this attribute triggers a structural reset of the shared memory segment when the writer is enabled.

attribute.name: connect
attribute.description:
Enables or disables the shared memory writer.
When enabled, the shared memory segment is created and kept up to date while DSP is running.
When disabled, the shared memory segment is invalidated and closed.

attribute.name: sample_rate
attribute.description:
Sets the write rate in Hertz.
Audio-rate signals are sampled at this frequency and the resulting scalar values are written to shared memory.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects how sampled values are written to shared memory.
In Raw mode, the most recent sampled value is written directly.
In RampSmooth mode, values are interpolated over time using a linear ramp defined by ramp_time_ms.

attribute.name: ramp_time_ms
attribute.description:
Duration, in milliseconds, used for RampSmooth interpolation.
This attribute has no effect when the smoothing mode is Raw.
